Sir,
Recruitment through Arunachal Pradesh Public Service Combined
I am directed to refer Commission's letter vide No.PSC-PJ14/05 dated 2
9-2006 on the subject cited above and to clariff the dou as under:-
Whether contract employees are entitled to concession of age relaxation at
par with regular Govemment employee?
Clarification: - the Contractual employee can not be considered as regular
employee because the term "contract" clearly indicates that the
appointment is for certain specified period and such appointment
automatically terminates on expiry of the specified date/time. Hence,
Contractual employee will not be entitled to concession of age relaxation
as provided to regular Govemment employee.
Yours Faithfully
(KIRBALOMI)
